simple.summary: נְאָקָה (nᵉʼâqâh) means a groan First listed occurrence: Exod 2 24.

definitions.full: H5009. neaqah נְאָקָה noun feminine groan, groaning ; — construct נַאֲקַת Exod 6:5 ; suffix נַאֲקָתָם 2:24 ; Judg 2:18 ; plural construct נַאֲקוֺת Ezek 30:24 ; — groaning of oppressed people Exod 2:24 ; 6:5 ; Judg 2:18 ; of a wounded man Ezek 30:24 ; ( ᵐ5 Co בִּזָּה וּבָזַז for נַאֲקוֺת וְנָאַק ᵑ0 but compare Berthol).
